goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse single-heartbeat runtime continuously on a StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated node using only node-local durable storage and native process supervision; third-party platforms may mirror source or validation evidence but cannot be required for deployment, scheduling, liveness, recovery, or worker leasing.
success_predicates: A StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated continuous carrier runs the canonical runtime
The carrier starts from an already-present local runtime source or StegVerse-distributed capsule without GitHub or provider fetch dependency
Heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt, worker-coordination and canonical-checkpoint state survive carrier restart/replacement
Runtime v9 owns internal heartbeat cadence and carries worker-coordination subsignals every cycle
Worker lease lifetime is measured in canonical heartbeat cycles derived from admitted task cost/runtime bounds
Restart/replacement continuity preserves or increments the one heartbeat epoch and creates no duplicate claim or fence
No ChatGPT automation, GitHub schedule, Render cron, Cloudflare process, Vercel process, or equivalent external scheduler/host owns worker activation
failure_predicates: Any third-party hosting, source-control, routing, CI, or scheduler provider is treated as a required production dependency
A provider outage or quota is treated as a production activation blocker
A stateless or sleeping carrier is presented as durable always-on activation without reconstructable state
A third-party scheduler becomes the normative heartbeat cadence or worker activation authority
Carrier restart/replacement loses or forks canonical heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt, checkpoint, or worker-coordination state

task.derivation_reason: Production activation must be StegVerse-native. Third-party provider availability is neither authority nor a blocker.

activation.recheck_trigger: a StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated node can execute scripts/install_sovereign_heartbeat_service.py from already-present local runtime material and directly expose activation/restart evidence

completion.next_authorized_action: A StegVerse sovereign node execution lane materializes and starts runtime v9 at the admitted high-frequency cadence, proves advancing heartbeat and worker-coordination state, performs controlled restart/reconstruction, and returns directly inspectable receipts.
terminal_when: A continuously executing canonical heartbeat carrier is active on a StegVerse-owned/federated node
Heartbeat cycle cadence is runtime-v9-owned and independent of third-party schedulers
Worker-coordination subsignal carries cycle-bound leases during execution
Master Records reconstruction restores canonical state after restart/replacement
StegVerse-Labs/.github#12 sovereign activation predicates are all satisfied

block.machine_observable_release_condition: one StegVerse-owned/federated node emits activation.latest.json plus heartbeat/worker checkpoint evidence before and after controlled native-service restart
